name: My Fake Goblin Wife
source:
You have the opportunity to become the husband of the Goblin Baroness. But what are your chances if this love is a sham?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你有機會成為哥布林女男爵的丈夫。可如果這份愛情只是一場騙局，你又有幾分勝算？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309120/]Steam[/url]]
